_doc: Per-company application caps. POLICY: default is NO CAP — most employers (e.g. Databricks) don't limit applications, so we don't throw away reach. We only cap a company once it has PROVEN a limit: either a manually-known policy or one auto-learned from a rejection/auto-close email (see agents/monitoring/email_monitor cap-learning). `default_max: null` = unlimited. Override a company by normalized (lowercased) name in `overrides` (the cap = max distinct roles within `window_days`, counting PENDING + SUBMITTED-within-window). `exempt` = staffing agencies where each posting is a different end-client. `learned` records auto-detected limits with provenance.

_known_hard_limits.roblox: 5 applications per 30 days (auto-closes the 6th) — confirmed via no-reply@roblox.com 2026-06-18; we cap at 4 for a safety margin.
